subject: Cedar Health — onboarding privacy package & subprocessor breakdown
messages:
From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@cedarhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <dpo@cedarhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Cedar Health — initial evidence request for onboarding

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week. As we move toward the internal procurement milestone, our InfoSec and privacy teams have a few data/process items we need before we can clear the legal review. Can you confirm the below and share evidence where available? We'd like to have these by EOD Friday if possible.

Requested items:
- Article 30 register excerpt or equivalent processing records for Redwood services used by Cedar Health
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or ATE/summary if full report restricted)
- DPIA summary for the integration pattern where PHI may be in scope (high level is fine)
- Full current subprocessor inventory (name, purpose, location, data categories processed)
- Confirmation of transfer safeguards for EU-origin data and any subprocessors outside the EU (SCCs/adequacy/derogation)
- KMS/HSM key custody model and whether customer-managed keys are supported
- Retention and deletion commitments for customer data (default and configurable)

Also: is there a standard DPA (we have a template we prefer) and a timeline for signing? If you can point us to a portal or shared folder for evidence that would be helpful.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement risk is blocking our pilot kick-off.

Thanks,
Evan Morris
Senior Procurement Manager
Cedar Health

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@cedarhealth.com>
Cc: Lina Park <dpo@cedarhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedar Health — initial evidence request for onboarding

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear list. Happy to help and we can hit the items you outlined. Quick plan from our side:

1) I'll assemble the privacy package (Article 30 excerpt, DPIA summary, subprocessor list).
2) Marissa will pull and redact the SOC 2 Type II cover + control summary; if you need the full report we can arrange an NDA/licensing step.
3) Karthik will provide a short write-up on transfer safeguards and KMS options.

Deliverables (target):
- subprocessor_inventory_2027-09.csv (attached stub today, full inventory link in Drive)
- redwood_privacy-pack-index.pdf (index w/links to Article 30 excerpt & DPIA summary)
- SOC 2: summary enclosed; full report available via secure link after an access request

We will upload primary artifacts to a shared evidence folder and send DocuSign for the DPA. If Friday EOD is tight we can prioritize the Article 30 excerpt + subprocessor inventory first and follow up with SOC 2 + DPIA notes.

Proposed next step: 30 min intake call tomorrow 10:00 AM ET to review any Cedar-specific data flows (especially PHI touchpoints). Does that work?

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Privacy Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- subprocessor_inventory_2027-09.csv (CSV stub: columns: name,purpose,location,data_categories,contact)
- redwood_privacy-pack-index.pdf (PDF stub: index and delivery plan)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@cedarhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <dpo@cedarhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedar Health — initial evidence request for onboarding

Hi Evan / team,

Following up on Hannah's note — a couple of clarifications from privacy ops to help speed review:

- For the Article 30 register, we'll provide an extract scoped to Cedar's service usage (processors & subprocessors tied to inference and embeddings pipelines). That will include legal basis and categories processed.
- DPIA: we maintain an internal DPIA summary for each model/integration class; for Cedar I'll surface the section covering potential PHI processing and mitigations (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, role-based access, KV caching exclusions).
- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II (Redwood Inference) cover and control mapping. If Cedar requires the full report, please send the standard access request form and intended recipients.
- Sampling: if Cedar wants log samples (request traces, audit events), let us know target windows and we will produce redacted extracts where permissible.

I attached the SOC 2 summary with control mapping to the GDPR/Art.28 expectations. Also: please confirm whether Cedar requires a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA/PHI — we have a separate process for BAAs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Privacy Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- soc2-type2-redwood-2026.pdf (summary + control mapping, redacted sections noted)
From: Lina Park <dpo@cedarhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Morris <evan.morris@cedarhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedar Health — initial evidence request for onboarding

Thanks for the fast responses and the materials so far — much appreciated. A couple of follow-ups after a quick review of the subprocessor list you sent:

1) One subprocessor flagged: "CloudEdge Analytics" (listed as processing in India). Can you confirm whether processing for Cedar accounts would occur on India infrastructure or be limited to EU/US nodes? If India is in-scope, please confirm the transfer mechanism (SCCs in place, or alternative safeguards).

2) For the DPIA summary, could you include a short section on data minimization and KV cache policies (specifically whether prompts or outputs are stored, and retention window)?

3) For SOC 2 access: we will complete the access request form if you can share the link. We prefer to get the full report under an NDA rather than a summarized mapping.

If possible, please answer 1 & 2 ahead of the intake call — those are blockers for legal.

Best,
Lina Park
Data Protection Officer
Cedar Health

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <dpo@cedarhealth.com>, Evan Morris <evan.morris@cedarhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T15:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedar Health — initial evidence request for onboarding

Hi Lina / Evan — quick answers and next steps:

1) CloudEdge Analytics: for Cedar we do not route inference payloads to India by default. Their role in our stack is analytics/telemetry for anonymized usage metrics; where customers require, we restrict telemetry collection and can exclude Cedar from India-based processing. For any subprocessor processing outside the EU, SCCs are in place (we maintain signed SCCs or equivalent transfer agreements). Karthik has attached a short note on transfer safeguards and will follow up with the annex describing subprocessors covered by SCCs.

2) DPIA / KV cache: our default runtime does not persist prompt/output content in long-term storage. Short-lived KV caches are used for latency optimization (ephemeral, TTL < 1 hour unless customer configures otherwise). We will include these specifics in the DPIA summary for Cedar, and note options to disable KV caching or use customer-managed keys.

3) SOC 2 access: thanks — here is the access request form link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/soc2-request (once filled we will provision the report under NDA).

Next steps:
- I'll upload the Article 30 excerpt + amended subprocessor row for CloudEdge to the Drive folder by EOD today.
- Karthik will add a short Annex A (transfer safeguards & SCC coverage).
- Marissa will share the SOC 2 access process if Cedar completes the form.
- Proposed intake call remains tomorrow 10:00 AM ET — we'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min session focused on PHI handling & retention.

If you prefer a written confirmation for the BAA question, we can escalate to legal and share the standard BAA template used for HIPAA customers.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Privacy Manager, Redwood Inference

- (drive links added to redwood_privacy-pack-index.pdf)
